name: Will's Journal
content:
Will's Journal - Entry One

Ant has gone missing, he ran ahead and now we can't find him. Something keeps screaming and shouting around here too. JW said it's just a fox but it sounds almost human to me. I swear I'll kill the new guy if he's playing a prank.|Entry Two

I'm alone down here. Brad wondered back to find the elevator, he seemed over the whole thing, the sounds really bothered him whilst JW ran ahead to catch-up with Ant.

Why did she leave me like that? I think the other exit is close-by, but I think it was locked somehow.|It's worse than I thought. I found the exit, but the lever is missing so I'm stuck here.

I remember that JW hid it in the bathrooms, but they're blocked off and you have to crawl through a ventilation shaft in storage to get there.|My flashlight battery is almost dead now and I'll never find my way there in the dark.

Those sounds never stopped either, they just drone on and on, like they're calling out for something or someone.

This creepy trip blows.|Final Entry

Ant is dead. I don't know what the hell happened but he's gone, torn into pieces and left in a pool of his own blood. There's no sign of JW.

I ran away and hid but soon, it will be me and the darkness, and the screams... Please God, protect me!|The screams are closer now... They're so loud. All around me. I don't want to die. I still ha-
